author: Inside Edition
description: Every week, a group of full-throated seniors gathers at the Henry Street Settlement in lower Manhattan to sing together. But Young@Heart NYC isn't crooning your grandparents' playlist; instead, the chorus covers the likes of Olivia Rodrigo, LCD Soundsystem, and other contemporary artists. "People have misconceptions about seniors," music director David Nagler tells Inside Edition Digital, "and this group disproves a lot of that. Everyone's very high energy and very alert, funny and sharp."
title: 'Young At Heart' Seniors Cover Olivia Rodrigo, LCD Soundsystem
